description: Augmentation of 132/33kV Grid Substation at Kiribathkumbura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to award the above contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.
